original_secondary_candidate_blocks: fro'-werd-nes: The translation of tahpukhoth the plural of tahpukhah, "perversity," "foolishness" (from haphakh, "to turn about") in Proverbs 2:14, "delight in the frowardness of the wicked," the American Standard Revised Version "the perverseness of evil," margin "the evil man" (compare 2:12; some render "deceit"); 6:14 the American Standard Revised Version, "perverseness"; 10:32, "the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness," the American Standard Revised Version "speaketh perverseness," margin "is."
records.proposed_direct_print_reading: frō'werd-nes: The tr of תַּהְפֻּכוֹת, tahpukhōth, the pl. of tahpukhāh, “perversity,” “foolishness” (from hāphakh, “to turn about”) in Prov 2 14, “delight in the frowardness of the wicked,” ARV “the perverseness of evil,” m “the evil man” (cf ver 12; some render “deceit”); 6 14 ARV, “perverseness”; 10 32, “the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness,” ARV “speaketh perverseness,” m “is.”
records.documented_correction: Replaced expanded secondary English with printed tr/pl./ARV/m and restored primary Hebrew lemma; keep original final 'm is.' rather than conjectural completion.

original_secondary_candidate_blocks: haz'-ra, has'-ra (chacrah): Grandfather of Shallum, who was the husband of Huldah the prophetess (2 Chronicles 34:22). In 2 Kings 22:14, HARHAS (which see).
records.proposed_direct_print_reading: haz'ra, has'ra (חַסְרָה, hasrāh): Grandfather of Shallum, who was the husband of Huldah the prophetess (2 Ch 34 22). In 2 K 22 14, HARHAS (q.v.).
records.documented_correction: Replaced 'chacrah' and derivative long-form scriptural references with original Hebrew and source AV-style abbreviations; preserved the printed q.v. cross-reference.

original_secondary_candidate_blocks: hem'dan (חֶמְדָּן, hemdān, "pleasant"): A descendant of Seir, the Horite (Gen 36 26). Wrongly trd "Amram" by AV in 1 Ch 1 41 (RV "Hamran"), where the transcribers made an error in one vowel and one consonant, writing hamrān instead of hemdān.
records.proposed_direct_print_reading: hem'dan (חֶמְדָּן, hemdān, “pleasant”): A descendant of Seir, the Horite (Gen 36 26). Wrongly trᵈ “Amram” by AV in 1 Ch 1 41 (RV “Hamran”), where the transcribers made an error in one vowel and one consonant, writing hamrān (חַמְרָן), instead of hemdān (חֶמְדָּן).
records.documented_correction: Restored the two original Hebrew alternative written forms, original RV/AV abbreviations and superscript translation abbreviation trd.

original_secondary_candidate_blocks: se'-far-vits, se-far'-vits (cepharwim): In 2 Kings 17:31, the inhabitants of SEPHARVAIM (which see), planted by the king of Assyria in Samaria. They continued there to burn their children to their native gods.
records.proposed_direct_print_reading: sē'fär-vits, sē-fär'-vits (סְפַרְוִים, sĕpharwīm): In 2 K 17 31, the inhabitants of SEPHARVAIM (q.v.), planted by the king of Assyria in Samaria. They continued there to burn their children to their native gods.
records.documented_correction: Restored primary Hebrew, original pronunciation and printed abbreviated reference and q.v.; eliminated derivative secondary prose expansions.
